metadata.title: Direct proofs for spaces with cyclic parallel Ricci tensor
metadata.abstract: We give direct proofs of rigidity results for gradient Ricci solitons, compact quasi-Einstein manifolds with boundary, and critical spaces with cyclic parallel Ricci tensor. For solitons and quasi-Einstein manifolds, successive traces of first-order pointwise identities yield quadratic equations for the Ricci tensor and its modification. These equations imply radial flatness and radial $Q$-flatness, respectively, and the corresponding global rigidity theorems apply. For critical spaces, comparison of two expressions for the Laplacian of the Hessian gives a pointwise tensor identity whose scalar contraction yields a weighted divergence formula. Integration then gives the vacuum static, CPE, and Miao--Tam conclusions. The same comparison also proves Ricci parallelism pointwise for solitons and quasi-Einstein manifolds.

analysis.workSummary: 通过点态张量恒等式及其迹，给出循环平行 Ricci 条件下多类空间的直接刚性证明。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一梯度 Ricci soliton、准 Einstein 及若干临界空间的证明路线。
analysis.limitations: 主要贡献是证明与统一方法，具体结论仍依赖各类空间原有全局条件。 本条数学解读依据官方摘要与评论；论文全文尚未作数学审读，AI 披露另行核查。
